notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
An update is available that fixes the following issue:

[list]
[*][h3]Fixed a bug affecting one painting[/h3]
If the player picked up the object hidden in the painting and then left the game, the object could be picked up again.
[b][u]NOTE:[/u] If you collected multiple copies of this item before downloading this update, they may not be removed from inventory even after you solve the puzzle. It has no influence on the rest of the game.[/b]
[i]Thanks to Karlusha1029 for reporting this bug. [/i]
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
An update is available that fixes the following issue:

[list]
[*][h3]Fixed a bug affecting the paintings with several missing objects[/h3]
If the player placed at least one of the missing objects in the painting and then left the game, the painting was no longer unlocked if the player placed the remaining elements later.
[b][u]IMPORTANT:[/u] If you have encountered this bug before downloading the update, you must manually fix your game save. To do that, simply press the "ctrl" and "D" keys on your keyboard at the same time while playing the game. The paintings in question will be unlocked. Sorry for the inconvenience.[/b]
[i]Thanks to Innocentive and Karlusha1029 for reporting this bug. [/i]
[/list]
